explanation: All three integrands and their t derivatives are continuous on local rectangles within their stated domains. The derivatives are 2tx cos(tx)−t²x² sin(tx), 2(x−t)/((x−t)²+1)², and x/(x−t)². II's denominator is always positive, and III's denominator cannot vanish for x∈[0,1], t<0. Thus all three qualify.
